main_new_title: A portfolio management service where you can record your activities
main_new_subtitle: You can record your hobbies, studies, school activities, etc.
main_new_feature1: ・Visualize deliverables with Gantt charts and lists
main_new_feature2: ・Share your activities and interact with others

faq_section1_q1_details: This application allows you to easily create, manage, and publish your portfolio.
faq_section1_q2_summary: Registration, Login, Withdrawal, and Password Reset Methods
faq_section1_q2_p1: You can create an account from "Register" on the top page.
faq_section1_q2_p2: You can log in with your registered information from "Login" on the top page.
faq_section1_q2_p3: You can withdraw from "Delete Account" on the settings page.
faq_section1_q2_p4: Please follow the procedure from "Forgot your password?" on the login page.
faq_section1_q3_summary: Usage Environment (Recommended Devices, Supported Browsers, etc.)
faq_section1_q3_details: PC usage is recommended. It works best with the latest version of Google Chrome or Firefox browsers.
faq_section2_q1_details: You can add, edit, and delete works from the dashboard.
faq_section2_q2_details: You can upload or change images and related files from the work editing page.
faq_section2_q3_details: You can toggle public/private settings on each work's editing page.
faq_section2_q4_summary: How to List, Search, and Filter Works
faq_section2_q4_details: Please use the search bar and filter functions on the dashboard.
faq_section3_q1_details: Please check if your email address and password are correct. If you have forgotten your password, please try resetting it.
faq_section3_q2_details: Please check if the file size and format meet the requirements. If the problem persists, please contact support.
faq_section3_q3_details: Please check if you have accidentally deleted it or if a search filter is active.
faq_section3_q4_summary: When Something is Wrong (Cache Clearing, etc.)
faq_section3_q4_details: Please try clearing your browser's cache and try again. If the issue does not improve, please contact support.
faq_section4_q1_details: Your data is encrypted and stored securely.
faq_section4_q2_details: You can check the details on the Privacy Policy page.
faq_section4_q3_details: By deleting your account from the settings page, all related information will be deleted.
faq_section4_q3_details_2: You can delete your account from the settings page.
faq_section5_q1_details: For inquiries, please contact us by email at <1>{{email}}</1>.
faq_section5_q3_summary: Information Required for Contact (User ID, etc.)
faq_section5_q3_details: When contacting us, please provide your registered email address and user ID.
faq_section6_q2_details: Introduced on our blog and Tips page.
faq_section6_q3_details: We will inform you on the announcements page and via email newsletter.
